newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SVCD Romania fund to sell off stake in listed company.
newsitem.headline: SVCD Romania fund to sell off stake in listed company.

text.p: Romania's main privatisation agency said on Monday it would auction off its 51 percent stake in listed fertiliser maker Azomures SA as part of moves to speed up privatisation of state assets.

The State Ownership Fund (FPS) is expecting sealed bids by Wednesday, with the winner to be named shortly afterwards, a spokesman said. So far letters of intent had been received from 13 local and foreign investors.
Azomures has a share capital of 172 billion lei. It was included in a 1995 mass selloff offering Romanians up to 60 percent in 4,000 state firms in exchange for coupons.
The Azomures stake in the share-for-coupon swap was about 30 percent and was oversubscribed. Some 19 percent had been previously sold in a public auction.
The bourse, which trades 17 companies, all listed on its second tier, decided last week to move Azomures to the top tier in view of its sound economic results and high liquidity.
Azomures had nine-month gross profit of 88 billion lei in January-September last year, according to stock exchange figures.

The fertiliser maker has dominated trading ever since the bourse opened more than a year ago, taking at least half of turnover at almost all sessions. Last Thursday, it closed 1,800 lei stronger at 27,800.
